verdict.rationale: Droid exec documents tiered autonomy that controls which operations run without manual confirmation, and the interactive CLI mentions approvals. That shows auto-approval is configurable, but the evidence never shows a tier or setting that approves every action. missing for 10: explicit evidence of an auto-approve-all/highest-autonomy setting, documentation of the tier levels and how to configure them in the interactive CLI and App, independent or hands-on corroboration.
